# Gordon's Notes

> > Personal blog covering technology regressions, fitness for aging athletes, financial planning, and life observations by John Gordon

A long-running personal notebook documenting experiences with CrossFit training for older adults, analysis of tech product decline (iOS, PalmOS, photo management software), practical guides on topics from Vanguard investing to bike donations, and commentary on social and political issues. The author brings a critical perspective on how consumer technology has regressed over time while sharing detailed guides for fitness, finance, and everyday challenges.

## Key Topics

- CrossFit and aging athletes
- Technology regressions (iOS, PalmOS, Aperture)
- Photo management software decline
- iPhoto and iCloud limitations
- Vanguard index fund investing
- Twin Cities bike donation
- Mountain biking and cycling
- Google products and services
- Apple ecosystem critique
- Tax deductions and charitable giving
- Fitness routines for seniors
- Back pain prevention exercises
- Middle class economics
- Software quality decline
- Personal finance automation

## Fitness and Aging Athletes

- [CrossFit for Olds - years to build ligaments and tendons](https://notes.kateva.org/2019/02/crossfit-for-olds-years-to-build.html): CrossFit advice for older adults on tendon and ligament development
- [Exercise on the exit ramp - the 30 year plan](https://notes.kateva.org/2014/11/exercise-on-exit-ramp-30-year-plan.html): 30-year fitness plan for aging athletes with CrossFit and triathlon
- [Exercising hard as an old person - one year of CrossFit](https://notes.kateva.org/2014/04/exercising-hard-as-old-person-one-year.html): One-year CrossFit review for senior fitness and aging athletes
- [My prophylactic back exercise routine](https://notes.kateva.org/2020/05/my-prophylactic-back-exercise-routine.html): Back exercise routine with Roman Chair and RDL for pain prevention
- [Pectus Excavatum complications - beware neck strike during barbell Clean](https://notes.kateva.org/2015/08/pectus-excavatum-complications-beware.html): Warning about Pectus Excavatum complications during CrossFit barbell Clean

- [Prosumer digital image management has not progressed to our advantage](https://notes.kateva.org/2023/04/prosumer-digital-image-management-has.html): Analysis of photo management software decline from PalmOS to iOS era
- [Android tablet price crash: do we have a cereal box computer yet?](https://notes.kateva.org/2013/05/android-tablet-price-crash-do-we-have.html): Commentary on Android tablet price collapse and computing predictions

## Personal Finance and Investing

- [Automated purchases of index funds - how to view and discontinue at Vanguard](https://notes.kateva.org/2016/12/automated-purchases-of-index-funds-how.html): Tutorial on managing Vanguard automated S&P index fund investments
- [How to donate used bikes (and why that may beat selling them)](https://notes.kateva.org/2015/07/how-to-donate-used-bikes-and-why-that.html): Guide to donating bikes in Twin Cities with Form 8283 tax deduction tips
- [What is middle class and what percentage of American voters can't get there?](https://notes.kateva.org/2020/11/what-do-i-mean-by-middle-class.html): Analysis of middle class income thresholds using Pew and FiveThirtyEight
